title: eriogonum vimineum var. densum
intro: Eriogonum vimineum var. densum, commonly known as Mountain Redstem, is a perennial shrub native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to support the immune system and reduce inflammation, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Redstem include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Redstem, such as eriogonum flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
